A Hannah Pennington therefore took her WKU degree in May 2010, which is exactly what a student sworn to the Student Senate in September 2008 would do, and it is not what the woman in WKU's 'Hannah Pennington Spotlight' of 25 January 2022 did: that article's subject came through the Gatton Academy, graduated in 2015 with the Mahurin Honors College CE/T of the Year and started medical school that autumn. Two different women. Do not publish wku.edu/img_news/article_images/10188.jpg. The 2010 advertisement is a name list and carries no photographs, so it gives a date and not a face.

name: DEFECTIVE SCAN: 2015 Talisman, printed pages 268-313
fact: TopSCHOLAR's scan of the 2015 Talisman: Resurgence (dlsc_ua_records/8679) is missing its entire student PORTRAITS section. The folios run continuously to 267 on PDF page 138 and resume at 314-315 on PDF page 140, with one uncaptioned full-bleed image between them; no page in the file carries a folio between 268 and 313. The book's own back index, which IS in the file, indexes people to those pages, so they exist in print: 'Scaff, Tyler 290', 'Smith, Sherry 291', 'Spalding, Shelley 292', 'Wilkins, Hayley 295', 'Havel, Catherine 279'. Tyler Scaff, the Campus Improvements chair of 2013-14 and 2014-15, therefore has a printed portrait at p. 290 that cannot be reached through TopSCHOLAR. There is no Part II: records 8677 and 8678 are the two 2016 issues and 8676 and 8680 are unrelated collections. If a complete copy of this volume ever surfaces, page 290 is the single highest-value page in it for this archive.

name: SOURCE NOTE: the 2015 Talisman club pages
fact: The club and organisation spread of the 2015 Talisman, printed pp. 316-333, is worth knowing about because it is half usable and half not. Some groups are keyed positionally, 'Row 1: ... Row 2: ...', and those are identifications this archive accepts: that is how Laura Harper was placed in the Revolution 91.7 photograph on p. 328. The large groups, chiefly the sororities and the honour societies, are captioned with a single alphabetical list and no positions at all, and a grid of faces against an alphabetical list identifies nobody. Checked and refused on that ground: Megan Skaggs on p. 323, Sarah Hazelip and Ashley Presnell on p. 329, Alexis Baker and Hayley Wilkins and Catherine Havel on p. 316, Brenna Duncan and Alyson Manley on p. 327, Catherine Havel and Alyson Manley again on p. 331. Do not cut faces from those.

name: Mallory Treece
fact: One further source checked and refused. The 2015 Talisman's election feature 'Gunning For It', pp. 58-59, is built round her honours thesis on party affiliation and gun ownership and calls her a Bowling Green senior, but the single photograph on the spread is a hunting scene credited to Ditte Lysgaard Holm with no caption and no person identified.
